verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own get-started docs say developers can use webhooks to receive notifications asynchronously once a transcription job completes, which removes the need to poll for completion. That is the only mention, so the webhook's behavior and depth are unproven. Missing for 10: evidence that the callback also fires on job failure, documentation of how to register the callback URL and what the payload contains, retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
